title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-tmmj: transcript_4 hashes plaintext instead of CIPHERTEXT_3 per RFC 9528
description:
Commit e041143 renames the `transcript_4` parameter from `ciphertext_3` to `plaintext_3`. The rename accurately reflects what callers pass (plaintext), but this is itself a spec violation.

**RFC 9528 Section 4.1:** TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3)

The CIPHERTEXT_3 input should be the raw encrypted message_3 bytes on the wire (including AEAD tag), not the decrypted plaintext.

**Call sites passing plaintext instead of ciphertext:**
- Line 919: `transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &plaintext_3.0, &credential_i)` — should pass `&ciphertext_3` (after tag extension at line 917)
- Line 1347: `transcript_4(&self.state.th_3, &pending.plaintext, peer.credential)` — should pass the raw CIPHERTEXT_3
- Line 1637 (test): `transcript_4(&th_3, &plaintext_3, &credential_i)` — test oracle may be self-referential (derived from broken implementation)

**The rename is harmful** because it makes the code "look correct" (parameter name matches what callers pass) while hiding the real bug. The original name `ciphertext_3` was at least a documentation of what SHOULD be there.

**Fix required:**
1. Rename parameter back to `ciphertext_3`
2. Fix all callers to pass the raw CIPHERTEXT_3 (encrypted message_3 bytes including AEAD tag), not plaintext_3
3. Validate test vector against an independent oracle (Python EDHOC impl or RFC test vectors)
